queries.sql: CREATE DATABASE IF NOT EXISTS payment_demo

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS payments (payment_id string, version bigint, operation string, amount_cents bigint) LOCATION 's3://YOUR_BUCKET/payment-demo/iceberg/payments/' TBLPROPERTIES ('table_type'='ICEBERG','format'='parquet')

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS settlements (payment_id string, version bigint, operation string, amount_cents bigint) LOCATION 's3://YOUR_BUCKET/payment-demo/iceberg/settlements/' TBLPROPERTIES ('table_type'='ICEBERG','format'='parquet')

CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW reconciliation AS WITH keys AS (SELECT payment_id FROM payments WHERE operation='U'
 UNION SELECT payment_id FROM settlements WHERE operation='U'),
 compared AS (SELECT k.payment_id, p.amount_cents AS expected_cents,
 s.amount_cents AS settled_cents FROM keys k
 LEFT JOIN payments p ON k.payment_id=p.payment_id AND p.operation='U'
 LEFT JOIN settlements s ON k.payment_id=s.payment_id AND s.operation='U')
 SELECT payment_id, expected_cents, settled_cents,
 CASE WHEN expected_cents IS NULL THEN 'ORPHAN_SETTLEMENT'
 WHEN settled_cents IS NULL THEN 'MISSING_SETTLEMENT'
 WHEN expected_cents<>settled_cents THEN 'AMOUNT_MISMATCH'
 ELSE 'MATCHED' END AS status,
 COALESCE(settled_cents,0)-COALESCE(expected_cents,0) AS variance_cents
 FROM compared

CREATE EXTERNAL TABLE IF NOT EXISTS stage_batch1_payments (payment_id string, version bigint, operation string, amount_cents bigint) ROW FORMAT DELIMITED FIELDS TERMINATED BY ',' STORED AS TEXTFILE LOCATION 's3://YOUR_BUCKET/payment-demo/staged/batch1/payments/' TBLPROPERTIES ('skip.header.line.count'='1')

CREATE EXTERNAL TABLE IF NOT EXISTS stage_batch1_settlements (payment_id string, version bigint, operation string, amount_cents bigint) ROW FORMAT DELIMITED FIELDS TERMINATED BY ',' STORED AS TEXTFILE LOCATION 's3://YOUR_BUCKET/payment-demo/staged/batch1/settlements/' TBLPROPERTIES ('skip.header.line.count'='1')
SELECT count(*) FROM stage_batch1_payments s JOIN payments t ON s.payment_id=t.payment_id AND s.version=t.version WHERE s.operation<>t.operation OR s.amount_cents<>t.amount_cents
SELECT count(*) FROM stage_batch1_settlements s JOIN settlements t ON s.payment_id=t.payment_id AND s.version=t.version WHERE s.operation<>t.operation OR s.amount_cents<>t.amount_cents

SELECT count(*) FROM (SELECT payment_id,version,operation,amount_cents FROM (SELECT *, row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY payment_id ORDER BY version DESC) AS rn FROM stage_batch1_payments) WHERE rn=1) s LEFT JOIN payments t ON s.payment_id=t.payment_id WHERE t.payment_id IS NULL OR s.version>t.version

MERGE INTO payments t USING (SELECT payment_id,version,operation,amount_cents FROM (SELECT *, row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY payment_id ORDER BY version DESC) AS rn FROM stage_batch1_payments) WHERE rn=1) s ON t.payment_id=s.payment_id
            WHEN MATCHED AND s.version>t.version THEN UPDATE SET version=s.version, operation=s.operation, amount_cents=s.amount_cents
            WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN INSERT (payment_id,version,operation,amount_cents) VALUES (s.payment_id,s.version,s.operation,s.amount_cents)

SELECT count(*) FROM (SELECT payment_id,version,operation,amount_cents FROM (SELECT *, row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY payment_id ORDER BY version DESC) AS rn FROM stage_batch1_settlements) WHERE rn=1) s LEFT JOIN settlements t ON s.payment_id=t.payment_id WHERE t.payment_id IS NULL OR s.version>t.version

MERGE INTO settlements t USING (SELECT payment_id,version,operation,amount_cents FROM (SELECT *, row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY payment_id ORDER BY version DESC) AS rn FROM stage_batch1_settlements) WHERE rn=1) s ON t.payment_id=s.payment_id
            WHEN MATCHED AND s.version>t.version THEN UPDATE SET version=s.version, operation=s.operation, amount_cents=s.amount_cents
            WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN INSERT (payment_id,version,operation,amount_cents) VALUES (s.payment_id,s.version,s.operation,s.amount_cents)

SELECT status, COUNT(*) AS records, SUM(COALESCE(expected_cents,0)) AS expected_cents, SUM(COALESCE(settled_cents,0)) AS settled_cents, SUM(variance_cents) AS variance_cents FROM reconciliation GROUP BY status ORDER BY status
